subject: allow building with external libs (#85)
reason: The change is purely a build and CI change: it adds a WITH_SUBMODULES_SYSTEM CMake option, a ci/build_ubuntu.sh script, prebuilt dependency .deb packages, and rewrites cmake modules to locate gRPC/protobuf/abseil/GTest/highwayhash via find_package instead of hardcoded submodule paths, renaming create_proto_library along the way. No C++ source or header is modified, the pinned dependency versions are unchanged, and the module's runtime behaviour is identical on both commits, so there is nothing a scenario could reach or compare.
